newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tubacex sees 1997 market outlook "very positive".
newsitem.headline: Tubacex sees 1997 market outlook "very positive".

text.p: Spanish steel tube-maker Tubacex said on Tuesday the outlook for 1997 was optimistic, with orders bouyant.

"The prospects for the market for the entire year are very positive, in terms of both volumes and prices. Orders pending for tubing, both cold-rolled and hot-rolled, comprise production up to December, and orders for 1998 have started to come in," the firm said in a statement accompanying first half results.
This would allow the firm to continue "its active policy of rewarding shareholders," Tubacex said.
In June, Tubacex said it expected 1997 net profit of 3.5 billion pesetas and 1998 net profit of 4.06 billion pesetas.
